_comment: ClaimRow schema for the Lit Review corpus (JSONL master). Single source of truth for required fields + enums. check_integrity.py imports this.

row_id._comment: stable within-doc id; with doc_id uniquely keys the row

doc_id._comment: canonical namespaced id: arXiv:<id> (version-stripped) or doi:<id>

claim._comment: what is asserted; MUST be a verbatim substring of claim_source_span

evidence_grade._comment: evidence-grading Preset C; this row's OWN source grade; rides on every row

grade_source_span._comment: the evidence quote justifying the grade

backed_by._comment: row keys doc_id:row_id of primaries that independently support this method (cross-paper link stage)

effective_grade._comment: method-level grade after cross-paper reasoning; A when independently reproduced; never weaker than evidence_grade
